annotations.title: Explain This Ladder — why The Ladder reads one NFL market the way it does

description: Why The Ladder reads one NFL strike ladder (a game spread, a season win total or a player prop) the way it does: the read in words, where Kalshi's ladder centres beside our projection, the widest published gap, and each strike with Kalshi's price and our number (30–70% only). Use for "explain the Chiefs win total ladder", "why does the ladder lean Browns".

family.description: Ladder family. Omit to take the team's spread first. One of: spread · season_wins · props.

player.description: Player name, full or partial — his prop ladder.

stat.description: Prop stat for a player, e.g. "receptions" or "rec_yds". Defaults to his widest ladder.

team.description: Team code or nickname (KC, Chiefs) — its game spread ladder, or its season-win ladder with family "season_wins".
